verdict.rationale: Langfuse is an LLM observability/prompt-management/evaluation platform, not an agent runtime that itself executes tasks using tools; the evidence only shows Langfuse exposing an MCP *server* for other agents (e.g., Cursor) to consume its docs/API, not Langfuse acting as an MCP *client* that plugs in external tool servers. This is a category error for the product type, so the axis does not apply.
